text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Fitted to past weather, day ahead, after the filter. Dashed black: observed power. Lines: median forecasts. Blue band: 80% interval of NS-U-K. Weeks fixed before any score was read; the coldest week has the lowest mean daily temperature of the year.'
